review.imagery: Root reviewed all 38 complete brochure spreads, the fourteen-page drawing-pack index, eighteen native resources and twenty-nine current website candidates. Twenty selected project renders retain architecture, apartment-interior or shared-amenity concept scope. Native drawing fragment, generic woman/lifestyle photographs, decorative texture, icons, logo and repeated compositions were excluded. The listing uses the project architecture render from brochure page 14. Current gallery additions preserve original image bytes and exact resource URLs.
review.floorPlans: Root read all fourteen delivered complete spreads and all twenty-three numerical GSA panels, including enlarged panel crops. The original paired apartment layouts and building keys remain together. Printed one-bedroom totals are 101.30,140.6,127.48,96.79,134.39,121.96 m². Two-bedroom totals are 162.8,170.14,205.26,205.56,196.12,181.38,254.56,198.7,195.7,226.5,179.28,208.39 m². Three-bedroom totals are 232.56,272.4,283.37,305.77 m². The four-bedroom total is 495.25 m². Type C 169.2 + 26.6 = 195.8 differs from printed 195.7. All other displayed component sums agree. The three-bedroom B1 sheet room table says A2, and the four-bedroom A sheet table says B1. Headers govern selector labels while source discrepancies stay explicit. The one-bedroom C1 header/table C wording is retained in the original sheet. Maid/study rooms do not increase headline bedrooms. Original PDFs, full notices and physical-page source links remain preserved.
review.location: Root read the complete current official JPEG, original regional sheet 9 and island master sheet 10. Six overlapping destination estimates agree. The brochure adds two separate 23-minute figures. Proposed souq, hotel, beach club and wider community features do not establish completion, private access or free services. No selected-building coordinate, live route, journey mode or kilometre distance was inferred. The generic sales-centre coordinates remain separate from project entrances.
review.provenance: Normal-GET source receipts retain current official HTML, original website image/map bytes and broker-hosted complete PDFs with dates and SHA256. Root verified native resources and full original source spreads before selection. Poppler renders retain original complete drawing content with lossless delivery. Existing researched commercial data, all IDs, slugs, aliases and ownership remain unchanged. The unsuccessful hyphenated /nawayef-park-views web open was followed by the canonical observed /nawayef-parkviews source route, already retrieved normally.
